pull.q: While offering a vast amount of programming options, strong focus is put on having performance critical features available as directly as possible.

quotes.t: A eurorack sequencer module designed for both live performance and work in the studio. It is based on the concept of step sequencing and can generate a wide variety of rhythms, melodies and modulation signals.
A highly configurable clock system allows the module to act both as a master clock or sync to many other modules or external gear.
